subject: English
passage: Maya Lin and James Carpenter were among the 200 architects who competed for the 1981 Vietnam Veterans Memorial design commission, a pivotal Washington D.C. competition that transformed public monument design. Though controversial at the time, a minimalist granite wall designed by Maya Lin—one of several proposals that received criticism from veterans' groups—______ the landscape architecture profession more than four decades later.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice A is the best answer. The convention being tested is subject-verb agreement. The singular verb "has influenced" agrees in number with the singular subject "a minimalist granite wall."
